title: Shared API, schema, or component contract

any: a public API or schema changes
multiple implementation surfaces share a contract
generated clients or reusable components change

skill_calls.when: the change crosses module or public-contract boundaries
producer and consumer changes need one versioned plan

nodes.obligation: Define producer, consumers, compatibility, versioning, and invalidation.

tests.evidence: producer and every named consumer agree on current schema and failure behavior

workline_policy: Use a separate workline when one authority must stabilize the contract before multiple consumers implement against it.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE when no public, shared, generated, or cross-surface contract changes.
repair: Contract drift reopens define-contract and only consumers bound to the changed version.
